items.title: 6.7 Enthalpy tabdeeli aur khoraak ka calorie content (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.7, printed pages 125-126.

blocks.text: Is hisse mein hum khane ko fuel (indhan) ki tarah dekhenge. Jab khana hazam (digest) hota hai to us mein jama chemical energy (jise calorie content bhi kehte hain) heat energy ban kar nikalti hai. Yani khana hazam hone par utni hi energy nikalti hai jitni use jism ke bahar jalane se nikalti. Is liye kul enthalpy of combustion heat of combustion ke barabar hai, jo calorimeter (aam taur par bomb calorimeter) mein napi ja sakti hai.

blocks.title: Calorie content
blocks.text: Khane ka calorie content us energy ka paimana hai jo khana jism mein poori tarah istemal hone par ‘nikalti’ hai. Yeh energy aam taur par kilocalories (kcal) ya joules (J) mein likhi jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek chammach cheeni se jism ko milne wali energy calorimeter mein cheeni jala kar kyun napi ja sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: Hazam hona aur jalna dono cheeni aur oxygen se shuru ho kar CO₂ aur pani par khatam hote hain. Hess’ law ke mutabiq shuru aur aakhir ek jaise hon to enthalpy change rasta badalne se nahi badalti, is liye dono mein energy barabar nikalti hai.

items: Khana fuel hai: hazam hone par utni hi energy nikalti hai jitni jalne par; yeh (bomb) calorimeter mein napi jati hai.
Calorie content: jism mein khane se milne wali energy, kcal ya J mein.
